upstream.vendored_license_note: The vendored license is text-identical to upstream after CRLF-to-LF normalization. Both byte-level hashes are recorded explicitly.

selection_policy: Extract and adapt only the named symbols; do not copy whole upstream modules unless every symbol is required.

excluded_capability_categories.rationale: NURSE fixes one ARK endpoint, one model, and an explicitly injected ARK_API_KEY2; discovery or fallback would violate the provider boundary.

excluded_capability_categories.category: unrelated transports and provider special cases
excluded_capability_categories.rationale: Anthropic, Bedrock, Codex, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama, and other provider paths are outside the fixed V1 contract.
TUI, gateway, shell, browser, file access, MCP, memory, delegation, and external search are not registered for either NURSE agent.
NURSE uses a deterministic allowlist and state machine; a general dispatcher would expand authority and make ordering harder to audit.
V1 records raw usage and latency without provider routing or network pricing lookup.
Reproduction must not depend on an installed HERMES profile, environment auto-discovery, or private application state.

selected_files.modifications: Retained bounded daemon-thread reads and safe closure; modernized typing, removed module logging, and added explicit non-negative bound validation.
Made records frozen and slotted, removed all provider-specific metadata, and kept only the fixed OpenAI-compatible fields and helpers.
Retained EmptyStreamError only; omitted SSL configuration and mixture-of-agents errors.

Reduced the loop to injected synchronous completion and dispatch functions with a fixed turn cap; removed credentials, provider fallback, TUI, hooks, MoA, compression, persistence, delegation, and built-in tools. Added opt-in return_at_turn_limit retaining the final tool trace without an extra completion; the default still raises.

Kept display masking and a fixed credential-text boundary, then added project-required recursive JSON-value redaction; removed plugins, configuration switches, terminal commands, files, browser/CDP, URL navigation, and logging integration.

Kept bounded JSON-object repair and deterministic call IDs, including safe Python literal normalization outside JSON strings; removed provider reasoning policies, image handling, broad message mutation, and raw-argument logging.
Retained Retry-After parsing only; removed jitter, adaptive delays, and provider-specific overload retry ceilings.

Retained strict OpenAI tool-result fields and composite-ID normalization; removed nonstandard name/tool_name wire extensions, serialized structured content as stable compact JSON strings, and removed generic dispatch, timestamps, filesystem logic, multimodal output, MCP, browser, and web wrappers.

Combined the abstract transport and one chat-completions adapter; removed provider profiles, prompt caching, reasoning-family branches, Gemini/OpenRouter handling, client construction, credentials, and fallback.
Kept canonical aggregation and OpenAI-compatible token buckets; removed Anthropic/Codex modes, billing routes, price tables, cost estimation, metadata, and network lookup.
